# Service charter v2 — digest

A curated digest of [CHARTER-v2.md](https://github.com/vesmaro/vesmaro-agent/blob/b8a51498accff8af7b507746cf46a2d72af9fd86/docs/decisions/CHARTER-v2.md)
from the vesmaro-agent repository (the pin is on the page badge). Document
status: draft; the Security Engineer verdict of 2026-09-29 is
approve-with-conditions with all ten findings amended into the text; the
“Accepted” stamp awaits SEC re-confirmation and the owner.

## Mission

vesmaro-agent is the **resident representative of the vesmaro-eyes board on
a host**: it inventories the agent harnesses living there, executes board
assignments through them, carries reports back with attribution, and makes
sessions/state visible to the owner — all **without reconfiguring the
host** (the node-exporter model: one binary, only its own loopback port).
The agent is **NOT the transport**: moving bytes between hosts is
mnemos-mesh (MM-033, phase C; the mesh leg rides the pinned mesh-core
library, credentials through their invite/enroll flow).

## Duties and phasing

| # | Duty | Phase |
|---|---|---|
| D1 | Inventory of installed harnesses | now (discovery v2+v3) |
| D2 | Assignment execution + supervision | now (working loop, allowlist) |
| D3 | Report intake from children | now (intake v0.5) |
| D4 | Attribution and capability discipline | now (spawn registry, per-child tokens) |
| D5 | Harness session sync | v0.6+ (session-fact seam → ME-020) |
| D6 | Operating harness files/configs | later (SEC-gated, sensitive zone) |
| D7 | Host state (light facts) | later (advisory discovery fields) |
| D8 | Self-update from the pipeline | later (signed artifacts + owner semaphore) |

## Never-list

1. **Not a transport** — transport is mnemos-mesh; the agent invents no
   protocols or credential flows of its own.
2. **Not a second node-exporter** — no metrics exporter, no scrape surface.
3. **Not a mini-OS** — no supervision of unrelated services, no package
   management, no cron, no host network configuration.
4. **Not a substitute for board validation** — the board stays the gate of
   its own verdicts (on the native Canon edge the agent IS the strict
   validator per ADR 0021 — delegation, not substitution).
5. **No instruction/session CONTENT in payloads** — names, counters,
   paths, hashes; the two bounded discovery v3 exceptions are the ceiling,
   not a precedent.
6. **No self-expanded authority** — discovery never extends the harness
   dictionary or auto-enables templates the owner has not confirmed.
7. **Not an egress surface** — the agent fetches only its configured board
   and mesh endpoints; URLs learned from child output are never fetched
   (no SSRF surface).
8. **The loopback listener is never a control plane** — report/intake
   routes only; no spawn triggers, no proxying.

## Principles

- **node-exporter model**: one binary, zero host reconfiguration, a
  `127.0.0.1` loopback bind with a kernel-assigned port; the board leg
  stays outbound-only; a public bind is a release blocker.
- **Secret minimum**: the executor secret in memory or a 0600 env file;
  per-child capability tokens instead of shared credentials;
  mask-before-truncate everywhere.
- **Fail-closed start and stay**: no CA → no connection; unparsable
  config → refuse everything; honest degradation over silent workarounds.
- **Ready-made solutions**: systemd, journald, node-exporter, mnemos-mesh —
  used, not rebuilt.

## Success metrics

- **M1** — discovery inventory visible in the UI (ME-021, live v3 payload).
- **M2** — every agent-spawned child has a session-fact in the task card
  ≤ 60 s after child exit; transcript viewable read-only (ME-020).
- **M3** — new-harness onboarding: agent-side ≤ 5 min, end-to-end ≤ 15 min
  including owner actions.
- **M4** — dead-letter < 10 %/day; `time_to_visible` p95 tracked; a
  fail-closed regression is a release blocker.

questions to the owner — lives only in the original (EN) linked above.
